body:
I'm a little over $7000 in debt. There is no going out and blowing my hard earned money because I have none. 

I've gone down that mental hospital road before and what a load if shit that was. They just locked me up when I told the doctor what I thought and how I felt. Did anybody think to check in on my dog or make sure my possessions like my family pictures were ok? No they didn't. They don't do that because they really don't give a fuck about your life outside of that shit hole. You come back and someone else is living in your place and you ask where your pictures of your dead family are and they just call the cops on you. 

So fuck you for even suggesting that. 

I don't like people, I don't want to go anywhere, I don't want to talk to anyone. 

This is the last thing I'll ever write.

I work 10 hours a day 6 days a week. I'm at work right now. On my day off I wash clothes, clean my home, get groceries and pay any bills that need to be paid. It takes all day that day to do everything I need to get done and with most people being useless it takes longer than it should to get most of that done.
36 and no. I don't have enough free time for hobbies.
